name: FIDEA Holdings Co. Ltd.
summary: FIDEA Holdings Co. Ltd., through its subsidiaries, provides various banking products and services to corporate and individual customers in Japan. The company offers negotiable certificates of deposit and lending services; asset and liability management services; and bills discounted products. It also manages securities, such as debt and equity securities, and investment trusts. In addition, the company offers deposits and loans, foreign exchange, securities-related, agency, custody/safe deposits and other services. FIDEA Holdings Co. Ltd. was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Sendai, Japan.
